text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Philippines and Bahrain agree to forge closer relations. Philippines President Ramos ended a two-day visit to Bahrain on Tuesday.
- Around 1,000 new hospital jobs to be available in Bahrain.
- Regional carrier Gulf Air says 28 people are still in hospital after a plane accident in Abu Dhabi airport.
- Gulf Arab ministers in charge of environment to meet in Bahrain on Wednesday.
- Prime Minister Sheikh Khalifa to open an expansion project at Sulmaniya hospital, built at a cost of 50 million dinars.
- Arab electricity ministers urged to speed up power grid linkage.
